panels.general_description: Twelve-lead ECG paper tracing with rapid, repeating wide complexes.
panels.detailed_description: Color scan of an ECG printout on pink millimetre grid paper, panel letter (A) at upper left. The tracing area is split into a left block and a right block of stacked lead rows. In the left block the rows show large, regularly repeating wide complexes that look similar from one row to the next, with one row carrying a finer, more jagged trace. In the right block the complexes are tightly crowded, narrower in spacing and larger in amplitude. Two black rectangular calibration markers lie along the bottom edge. Small lead labels beginning with V are faintly visible at the left edge of the right-hand block; the labels of the left block are not legible. A small hand-drawn blue ink mark is present near the upper right corner. No patient name, date, rate readout, paper speed or gain text is legible.

panels.general_description: Echocardiography strain bull's eye map with printed segment values and a summary text box.
panels.detailed_description: Black-background screen capture of a circular segmented bull's eye map titled Pic du Strain Syst. with the panel letter (A) at upper left. Segment region labels ANT_SEPT, ANT, LAT, POST, INF and SEPT are printed around the rim. Each of the segments is filled in red shades and carries a printed percent value; the printed values include -15, -12, -17, -22, -19, -23, -18, -20, -27, -29, -24 and -12, and a single positive 3 in a blue-tinted wedge next to the POST label. A vertical color scale at upper right is labelled 20.0 at the top and -20.0 with a percent sign at the bottom. A date-time stamp is printed at the lower right of the map. Below the map a text box lists GLPS_LAX -14.0 %, GLPS_A4C -23.3 %, GLPS_A2C -23.8 % and GLPS_Avg -20.4 %, and a second box lists AVC_AUTO 314 msec, HR_ApLAX 62 bpm and FR_min 70 fps.

panels.general_description: Twelve-lead ECG paper tracing with rapid, uniform wide complexes and device text at the bottom.
panels.detailed_description: Color scan of an ECG printout, panel letter (A) at upper left. A short header label at the top left is partly legible as a demographic field label with no legible value. Lead labels I, II, III, aVR, aVL and aVF are printed down the left block and V1 to V6 down the right block. Every row shows rapidly repeating, tall, wide complexes that look alike from beat to beat; the V6 row is a lower, finer oscillation. Device text near the bottom left reads 0.67~100 Hz, 25 mm/sec, 10 mm/mV, a heart symbol followed by 168, and SE-601C V1.2. Two black rectangular markers lie along the bottom edge.
